biox.resource_is_not_a_network: The resource is not a network
biox.validate_experiment_help_text: You're about to validate the experiment. During the validation, the experiment is sent to the collaborative space. Once it is validated, it can't be updated nor deleted. The experiment must be linked to a project
biox.remove_experiment_from_queue_confirmatio: Remove the experiment from execution queue ? It will not be executed.
biox.sync_object_need_project: You need to attach the object to a project to sync it with Central
biox.sync_object_confirmation: Sync the object with Central ? Once the object is synced, it can't be attached to another projet. The synchronized objects are visible in Central.
biox.sync_report_confirmation: If the report is associated with experiments, the experiments will also be synced.
biox.stop_experiment_confirmation: Are you sure you want to stop the experiment ?
biox.reset_experiment_confirmation: Are you sure you want to reset the experiment ? The experiment can't be reset if one of its output resources is used in another experiment. The generated resources will be delete and experiment status set to draft.
biox.delete_experiment_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete the experiment ? The experiment can't be deleted if one of its output resources is used in another experiment. The generated resources will be delete.
biox.delete_experiment_sync_confirmation: This experiment is synced with Central, it will also be removed from Central.
biox.clone_experiment_confirmation: Do you want to duplicate the experiment ? The processes and the configurations will be copied but not the resources.
biox.import_resource_text: Import a file or a folder to a resource. A new resource will be created.
biox.resource_import_no_config: No configuration required to import the resource
biox.validate_report_help_text:
You're about to validate the report. During the validation the report will be sent to the collaborative space. Once validated the report can't be updated nor deleted.

If the report is related with experiments, the related experiments will be automatically validated.

The report must be linked to a project to be validated.
biox.delete_report_confirmation: Are-you sure you want to delete the report ? Once deleted it can't be recovered.
biox.report_disassociate_experiment_confirmat: Do you want to disassociate the experiment from the report ?
biox.update_resource_type_help: You can update the type of the resource only if the resource is not used in an experiment
biox.view_config_select_help:
Here is the historic of the views you have generated. You can only search on views of resources that were generated or used by one of the experiments related to this report. 
If you don't find the view you want, re-generate it from the resource page and re-launch the search, the view should appear in the first position.

biox.select_project_help: You can select a project now to organize you objects and synchronize them with Central. If you don't select a project, you can do it later in the object page.
biox.delete_share_link_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete the share link ? The link will be expired
biox.share_link_object_not_found: The associated object might have been deleted and was not found, this link is not valid anymore
biox.share_object_help: You can share an object with a link that will be valid for a limited time. Anyone with the share link will be able to view and download the object. You can delete the share link at any time.
biox.import_from_another_lab_help: You can import resources from another lab. You need to provide the share link of the resource you want to import. The resource will be imported in your lab and you will be able to use it like any other resource.
biox.not_shared_yet: No lab downloaded the object yet
